facts.value: The Bachelor's programme in Biological Sciences imparts knowledge of the various sub-disciplines of biology and related fields. It lays the foundation for the exploration of life processes at different levels - from the molecular level through subcellular compartments, cells, tissues, or organs, unicellular and multicellular organisms to ecosystems. It focuses not only on a static capture and description but, above all, on understanding relationships and dynamic processes. The broad-based programme provides insight into many sub-disciplines of biology as well as the fundamental knowledge in chemistry, physics, and mathematics necessary for their understanding. It allows for specialization through the offer of an elective area and concludes with a bachelor's thesis.
